title: Aerated French Polish Puff Pastry
description: A light, airy, and flavorful pastry featuring the taste of tarragon leaves, made with a long-fermentation dough and a jammy filling. Perfect for a Whole30-friendly dessert or snack.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out a large rectangle from the dough, about 12 inches by 8 inches.
Spread a thin layer of jam onto the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the tarragon leaves over the jam.
Fold the dough over the filling to create a rectangular shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a decorative border around the edges of the pastry.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pastry for 25 minutes, or until it's golden brown.
Let the pastry cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing and serving
